source_changes: PreparedNativeJoint borrows original immutable requests, prepares once across bound-only Newton correction trials.
FrozenSystems owns a mutex-protected rod-local factor and exact-load cache for its immutable pose/dt lifetime.
Matrix, RHS, active DOFs and band-width identities are checked before cached use.
Load keys preserve exact float bits, signed zero and subnormals.
At most128 retained columns and256KiB key/value payload per rod, excluding HashMap/identity/factor overhead; overflow computes fresh without dropping loads.
Prepared output dimensions checked before physical solve; original force balance, bounds admission and sorted retry retained.
benchmark_scope: 3-rod 1-contact complete immutable projection, warm cache, seven alternating pairs x100 evaluations;1.42x median; concurrent full qualifier load; not isolated cache-only or full-frame result.
